description: This Java source file defines the HostValidator class, which validates hostnames against a set of blocked and allowed addresses and hostnames. It includes logic for resolving hostnames, checking addresses against various criteria (loopback, multicast, site-local), and producing validation results or exceptions when validation fails.

classes.name: HostValidator
classes.description: Validates hostnames against forbidden addresses and allowed hostnames, providing mechanisms for custom hostname resolution and detailed validation results.

classes.name: HostValidator.HostValidationResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome of hostname validation, indicating whether the hostname is valid, blocked, or invalid, with methods to generate exceptions for invalid cases.

methods.name: validateHost
methods.description: Checks whether a hostname is permitted based on allowed hostnames and resolved IP addresses, considering loopback, site-local, multicast, and blocklist addresses.

methods.name: calculateBlockedAddresses
methods.description: Resolves blocked hostnames into IP addresses to be blocked, logging unresolved hostnames.

methods.name: validateHostname
methods.description: Validates a hostname and throws an exception if it is not permitted.
